title.desc: Header title text. Ignored when #title slot is provided.

icon.desc: Material icon name shown before the title.

icon-color.desc: CSS color value for the header icon.

footer-text.desc: Simple text displayed in the footer bar.

square.desc: Remove border-radius for a square appearance.

fullscreen.desc: Panel takes up the full viewport (fixed positioning).

scroll.desc: Enable vertical scrolling for the default slot content.

default.desc: Main content area of the panel.

title.desc: Replaces the default title text. The header icon still renders if the icon prop is set.

header.desc: Content inserted between the title and header-action areas.

header-action.desc: Right-aligned content in the header bar (e.g. buttons, tabs).

footer.desc: Footer content. Rendered alongside footer-text if both are provided.
